tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested an upgrade to the latest LTS version. .NET 10.0 is the current latest LTS, succeeding .NET 8.0. Upgrading ensures access to the latest performance improvements, security patches, language features, and long-term support through the .NET 10 lifecycle.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade all projects in the eShopOnWeb solution (ApplicationCore, BlazorAdmin, BlazorShared, Infrastructure, PublicApi, Web, UnitTests, IntegrationTests, FunctionalTests, PublicApiIntegrationTests) from net8.0 to net10.0. Update the SDK version in global.json from 8.0.x to 10.0.x. Update the TargetFramework in Directory.Packages.props and any project files that reference it. Update all NuGet packages (ASP.NET Core 8.x, Entity Framework Core 8.x, and related packages) to their .NET 10-compatible versions. Resolve any breaking API changes or deprecated APIs between .NET 8 and .NET 10. Ensure the solution builds successfully and all tests pass after the upgrade.
tasks.summary: Upgraded eShopOnWeb solution from .NET 8.0 to .NET 10.0. Updated global.json SDK to 10.0.x, TargetFramework to net10.0 in all projects, updated NuGet packages (Azure.Identity 1.21.0, System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt 8.19.2), removed packages now built into .NET 10, and fixed breaking API changes (removed obsolete SerializationInfo constructor, fixed TimeSpan.FromMinutes ambiguity, resolved Program type ambiguity). Build succeeded with 0 errors and all 44 unit tests pass.
